body.name: Fixed-parameter minimal-polynomial algorithm
body.construction: In \(\mathsf{ArithmeticModel}\), reduce to \(\mathsf{Core}_{G,e}\), use randomized source-parameter identity tests and a coordinate-preserving generic slice, and test whether \(\lambda_e\) is algebraic over \(K_G\). If \(d_e(G)<\infty\), compute multiplication by \(\lambda_e\), descend its squarefree monic minimal polynomial to \(K_G\), and return the finite tag \((d_e,p_e,\mathcal Q_{G,e},h_{G,e})\). If \(d_e(G)=\infty\), return exactly the transcendental tag \((\infty,\mathcal N_{G,e})\), where \(\mathcal N_{G,e}\) certifies dominance of the queried-coordinate projection from a positive-dimensional irreducible generic-fiber component onto \(\mathbb A^1_{K_G}\); do not construct or return \(p_e\), \(\mathcal Q_{G,e}\), or \(h_{G,e}\) on this branch.
